text:
zoe: VoltBend asked for a head-to-head perf/W and p95/p99 throughput run next week for marketplace onboarding. They want reproducible numbers + a 1-page embargoed figure pack.

marc: What rig access do they give? VPN/perfmon? model shape?

oliver-voltbend: We can enable VPN and perfmon on rigs B1/B2 by Tue EOD. Using model: starlight-small, seq 512 and 2048.

lee: Test plan: modes: fp16, int8, q4_0. Kernel variants: stock, fused-attn, cublas-tuned. Include powercap curve (200/250/300W) and KV-cache thrash. Steady-state windows for perf/W.

anya: Telemetry minimal fields: run_id, ts, host_pdu_w (1s), gpu_power_w, latency_p50/p95/p99, ipc, l2_miss. Aggregated CSV + PNGs shared; raw traces require NDA addendum.

zoe: Owners: Marc = bench ops, Lee = kernel tuning, Anya = telemetry/analysis, Zoe = PM/announce. Agreed?

marc: Agreed. I'll schedule dry-run Wed, tuning Thu, final sweep Fri if VPN up. Need partner to allow perfmon and kernel debug.

bench-bot: Run scheduled: id=bench-1767123456 start=1767200000. Modes queued: fp16,int8,q4_0.

lee: Please pin driver/stack in logs: nvidia-535 / cuda-12.1 / cublas-12.1. We'll try ATTEN_FUSE=1 and CUBLAS_TUNE=3 for tuned runs. Add quality regression hook for token logprob delta.

oliver-voltbend: We can match that stack on B1; B2 is older driver and will be flagged in the notes. I'll confirm VPN/perfmon Tue AM and start NDA flow for raw dumps.

anya: Bucket: s3://redwood-partner-voltbend/bench-1767123456. Grant aggregated-read to voltbend-marketing. Raw traces write pending NDA.

zoe: Action items: 1) Oliver enable VPN+perfmon Tue. 2) Marc prep harness and dashboard. 3) Lee provide tuning knobs and safe defaults. 4) Anya create telemetry bucket and ingest rules. 5) Zoe open NDA addendum with Legal and draft embargoed figure pack.

marc: Runner snippet for ops:
```bash
run-bench --model starlight-small --seq 2048 --modes fp16,int8,q4_0 \
  --dur 3600 --powercaps 300,250,200 \
  --telemetry s3://redwood-partner-voltbend/bench-1767123456 \
  --rigs B1,B2
```

zoe: If no blockers I'll send kickoff to Oliver and flip the bench-bot to start the dry-run. Thanks all!
